heading: Wednesday, May 14, 2025
topLine: DeepMind's AlphaEvolve improves known results on about 20% of 50+ open problems.

items.headline: DeepMind's AlphaEvolve improves known results on about 20% of 50+ open problems
items.summary: Google DeepMind's AlphaEvolve is a Gemini-powered evolutionary coding agent. On more than 50 open problems in analysis, geometry, combinatorics and number theory, DeepMind reports that it matched the best known constructions in about 75% of cases and improved on them in about 20%. Highlights include multiplying 4x4 complex-valued matrices with 48 scalar multiplications, which DeepMind calls the first improvement over Strassen's 1969 method in this setting, and a configuration of 593 spheres that raises the kissing-number lower bound in 11 dimensions. These results are DeepMind's own claims for explicit, checkable constructions; the accompanying white paper (arXiv, June 2025) was not peer-reviewed. In Google's own systems, a scheduling heuristic it found recovers about 0.7% of worldwide compute.
